scope_note: Agent review on 2026-10-15 enriched one Fungal pathogen profile with two claims from the fresh indexed primary disease note: bounded field collection context and culture versus field-image interpretation. Added leaf-age/canopy context and lesion-to-culture capture linkage, without asserting a universal canopy preference, cultivar susceptibility ranking, field sporulation requirement or infection latency. Refreshed the existing citation access date and preserved its publisher-supported 2020-02-23 publication date; the university catalog records the May 2020 issue date, not a conflicting exact day. Direct publisher open returned HTTP 403; indexed primary text and the independently accessible author-institution bibliographic record were used, with no access barrier bypassed. The indexed note names Supplementary Figure S1 but no verified original asset URL or item-level reuse terms were recovered, so no media metadata, copied image/video, license grant or training sample was invented. Existing multilocus/laboratory linkage, human-review flags, empty media list and 0.30 image-only confidence safeguard remain. Profile/source/media counts remain 63/190/84; training-eligible media remain zero. New regression checks cover collection-versus-universal interpretation, culture-versus-field timing, sample identifiers and unchanged training/media safeguards. All 62 validators, 281 tests, type check, build, deterministic artifact freeze and diff checks passed locally. PHP is absent locally, so hosted lint remains required. The research-repair skill guided evidence-bound context expansion rather than speculative media admission. No production deployment or actual human/expert review is asserted.
